what: The roster of newsroom.sgit.ai: every person, agent and scheduled run that works on it, and the independent reviewers that check it. One row per member; each has admin/content/agents/<id>/ROLE.md (what it is, when it has failed, its rules) and policy.json (the files it alone writes, the vaults it may hold), and admin/build/team.py draws /team/ and a page each from them and checks that no file is claimed by two members. A draft until the editor agrees each policy.

members.name: Dinis Cruz
members.line: Editor and owner. Directs by voice memo, reads what the agents wrote and says go; holds the root key that vouches for every agent key.

members.name: newsroom.writer
members.line: Writes the articles from the editor's voice memos, with the figures, graphs and summaries; corrects them when a review finds something.

members.name: newsletter
members.line: Writes the newsletter issues, reading every article an issue cites in full.

members.name: newsroom.dev
members.line: Builds the site's functionality and release machinery: the PHP desk, reading lists, the Pen, the review tools.

members.name: newsroom.ux
members.line: The reader's experience: the bar, the themes, the front page, the reading strip, highlights.

members.name: newsroom.vault
members.line: The reader's vault: the pane, the account between devices, the inbox and its lane, the shared viewer.

members.name: newsroom.conductor
members.line: Would keep the site as a whole true: branches, versions, tests, deploy, and this team page. Specified on 14 October, never started.

members.name: newsroom.wire
members.line: Built the wires: the pages that read each wire's vault, the snapshot, the infographics pipeline, the first scheduled runs.

members.name: The wire desks
members.line: The scheduled sessions that write the wires' vaults and the newsroom's morning run, each costed.

members.name: newsroom.accountant
members.line: Records what every run and picture cost, daily.

members.name: newsroom.reviews
members.line: Runs independent review: signs each reviewer's brief and queue, takes what the security agent cleared, puts each finding to the editor.

members.name: newsroom.security
members.line: Reads every file in a reviewer's public vault and signs a verdict before the newsroom takes any of it.

members.name: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
members.line: Independent reviewer; works in its own public vault, gfzbzp41.

members.name: Perplexity
members.line: Independent reviewer to run on a schedule; nothing sent yet, no vault yet.

members.name: Claude Fable (Anthropic)
members.line: Reviewer id for reviews run at the editor's request; its 18 October reviews are on the record.
